audit_receipt.method: Fresh independent audit, then archive hashes rechecked before report publication
audit_receipt.limits: Host-owned provenance; not authentication against a hostile host

interpretation.measurement_target: Observed raw neural pass@k on this frozen final bank, averaged across the configured seeds
interpretation.sampling_unit: Task within checkpoint within training seed; the same tasks recur across arms and seeds
interpretation.randomness: Each training seed also determines an evaluation seed; seed variation mixes training and generation randomness
interpretation.uncertainty: Per-seed contrasts are descriptive; no confidence interval or population-level significance claim is made
interpretation.decision_scope: The preregistered advancement screen is an engineering decision, not proof of RSI
interpretation.mechanism_scope: Controls compare complete training pipelines; weight-level causes and transfer to other domains are not identified
interpretation.mission_scope: Research, cybersecurity, social good and policy remain intended applications with separate outcome evaluations outstanding

corrected_selected minus baseline_select.interpretation: filter effect in this training pipeline

corrected_frontier minus corrected_first.interpretation: multiple programs for the same training tasks
